# Amir Precision Cuts

> A barbershop on Ventura Boulevard in Encino for men who want the detail done properly — precision cuts, beard work shaped to the face, and traditional hot towel shaves.

men's barbershop in Encino, CA. By appointment only. Hours: Tue–Fri 9 AM–8 PM · Sat 9 AM–7 PM.

## Services
- Haircut — from $50: A cut shaped to how your hair actually grows, finished with a clean neckline and edges.
- Haircut and Beard Trim — from $70: The full reset — cut and beard in one sitting, with the two lines shaped to work together.
- Beard Trim — from $40: Shaped to the jaw and cheek rather than to a template, with the neckline taken down clean.
- Signature Haircut with Black Mask — from $100: A haircut finished with a charcoal mask over the face and neck. Lifts the skin before the detail work and leaves the edges sharper.
- Hot Towel Shave — from $60: A traditional straight razor shave, taken at the pace it needs, with hot towels either side.
- Scissor Cut — from $60: Scissor work over the whole head for length and movement, with no clipper over the top.
- Scissor Cut and Beard Trim — from $90: The same scissor work over the whole head, with the beard shaped to match in the same sitting.
